login.title: Welcome to BeerApp
login.subtitle: Sign in or create an account with your email. We’ll send you a code.

code.title: Check your email
code.subtitle: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}.
code.resendIn: You can resend it in {{seconds}} s

errors.codeExpired: The code is wrong or has expired. Try again or request a new one.
errors.tooManyEmails: You requested too many codes. Wait a few minutes.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

age.title: How old are you?
age.subtitle: To use BeerApp you must be of legal drinking age in your country.
age.underage: You must be at least {{age}} to use BeerApp.
age.responsible: Drink responsibly. Your birthdate and country can’t be changed later.

profile.title: Create your profile
profile.subtitle: This is how your friends will find you.
profile.usernameRules: 3–20 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, _ and . (not at the start or end).
profile.permissionDenied: Camera or photo access is needed. You can allow it in Settings.

profile.noBio: You haven’t written anything about yourself yet.
profile.privateHint: Only your friends will see your beers and stats.
profile.readOnlyHint: Username, birthdate and country can’t be changed.
profile.signOutConfirm: Do you want to sign out?
profile.privateNotice: This profile is private. Become friends with @{{username}} to see their beers.
profile.blockedNotice: You blocked @{{username}}. Neither of you can see the other.

about.title: About the app
about.offLicence: Beer data under the ODbL licence; images under CC BY-SA. © Open Food Facts contributors.
about.obdbLicence: Brewery data under the MIT licence.

scan.title: Scan a beer
scan.hint: Point at the barcode on the bottle or can.
scan.notFound: We don’t have this beer yet
scan.addSoon: Soon you’ll be able to add it yourself.
scan.unavailable: We can’t look it up right now. Check your connection and try again.
scan.rateLimited: You’ve done too many lookups. Try again in a while.
scan.invalid: This code isn’t valid. Scan it again.
scan.cameraWhy: We need the camera to read the barcode.
scan.cameraDenied: We don’t have permission to use the camera. You can allow it in Settings.

new.noResultsHint: Try another word or scan the barcode. Soon you’ll be able to add it yourself.
new.photoHint: You can add a photo or carry on without one.
new.caption: Text (optional)
new.publishError: Couldn’t post. Check your connection and try again.
new.photoPermission: Camera or photo access is needed. You can allow it in Settings.
new.photoGone: The photo you picked is no longer there. Choose another or carry on without one.

when.label: When?
when.retroNotice: It will be marked as a retroactive post.
when.feedOffHint: It will only be saved to your log.

edit.title: Edit post
edit.beerFixed: The beer and the photo can’t be changed. If you got it wrong, delete the post and make a new one.
edit.dateLocked: This post is verified: its date can’t be changed.
edit.saveError: Couldn’t save. Check your connection and try again.

delete.cannotUndo: The post and its photo will be deleted. This can’t be undone.
delete.error: Couldn’t delete. Check your connection and try again.

grid.emptyMine: You haven’t logged a beer yet.

friendship.removeHint: You’ll stop seeing each other’s private posts. You can send a new request later.
friendship.error: That didn’t work. Please try again.

friends.title: Friends
friends.emptyHint: Find someone by their @username and send them a request.

block.explain: You’ll stop being friends, neither of you will see the other, and they won’t be able to find you or send you requests. We won’t tell them.

blocked.title: Blocked users
blocked.unblockHint: You’ll see each other again as your privacy settings allow. The friendship doesn’t come back: you’ll need a new request.
